campaigns.name: Journeys Through Taebrin
campaigns.summary: The Forgotten Gods Saga: forgotten deities stir across the storied roads of Taebrin, and an unlikely band of misfits is caught at the center of the reckoning.
campaigns.description:
The Forgotten Gods stir beneath the ash of dead pantheons, and the unlikely heroes of Taebrin find themselves at the center of a divine reckoning. Across the green hills and shadowed forests of this bronze-age land of Saurian civilizations — through mire and council chamber alike — a wizard who cannot stop lying, an astral-touched sorcerer, a stoic cleric, and more must decide whether to wake old powers or bury them once and for all.

This is our currently-airing campaign. New episodes drop on the Tales of Aneria YouTube channel and podcast feed.
